zh-CN.title: 日历与广场体验优化
items: 添加空间运营者后自动成为好友，无需等待审批
精简应用与插件的内边距，名片日历改为原生周历和日程列表
优化广场详情返回时的位置恢复，保持手机 Header 的毛玻璃背景

en.title: Calendar and Square improvements
items: Space operator friend requests are now accepted automatically
Removed extra app drawer padding and replaced embedded calendars with a native weekly agenda
Improved Square scroll restoration and kept the mobile header backdrop stable on return
